question: 전립선암 환자는 총 몇 명인가요?
intent: count distinct prostate cancer patients
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s_patno) FROM poc.poc_prostate_patient_info

question: 연령대별 전립선암 환자 수를 알려줘
intent: count patients grouped by age band
sql: SELECT age_10_sect_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT s_patno) AS patient_count FROM poc.poc_prostate_patient_info GROUP BY age_10_sect_nm ORDER BY age_10_sect_nm

question: Gleason Grade Group별 검사 건수를 보여줘
intent: count pathology exams grouped by gleason grade group
sql: SELECT grade_group, COUNT(*) AS exam_count FROM poc.poc_prostate_path GROUP BY grade_group ORDER BY exam_count DESC

question: 2023년 이후 로봇 수술을 받은 전립선암 환자 수를 Gleason 위험군별로 알려줘
intent: count
sql:
SELECT
  ppath.grade_group AS gleason_risk_group,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pop.s_patno) AS patient_count
FROM
  poc.poc_prostate_op pop
JOIN
  poc.poc_prostate_path ppath ON pop.s_patno = ppath.s_patno
    AND TO_DATE(ppath.rslt_cnfm_dt, 'YYYYMMDD') <= TO_DATE(pop.op_dt, 'YYYYMMDD')
LEFT JOIN
  poc.poc_prostate_patient_info ppinfo ON pop.s_patno = ppinfo.s_patno
WHERE
  pop.op_dt IS NOT NULL
  AND TO_DATE(pop.op_dt, 'YYYYMMDD') >= DATE '2023-01-01'
  AND pop.inhosp_op_eng_nm IN ('Robotic Radical Prostatectomy (da Vinci)', 'Robot-assisted Radical Prostatectomy', 'Robot-assisted Laparoscopic Radical Prostatectomy')
GROUP BY
  ppath.grade_group
ORDER BY
  patient_count DESC
LIMIT 100
sql_before_edit:
SELECT
  ppath.grade_group AS gleason_risk_group,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pop.s_patno) AS patient_count
FROM
  poc.poc_prostate_op pop
JOIN
  poc.poc_prostate_path ppath ON pop.s_patno = ppath.s_patno
    AND TO_DATE(ppath.rslt_cnfm_dt, 'YYYYMMDD') <= TO_DATE(pop.op_dt, 'YYYYMMDD')
LEFT JOIN
  poc.poc_prostate_patient_info ppinfo ON pop.s_patno = ppinfo.s_patno
WHERE
  pop.op_dt IS NOT NULL
  AND TO_DATE(pop.op_dt, 'YYYYMMDD') >= DATE '2023-01-01'
  AND pop.inhosp_op_eng_nm ILIKE '%robot%'
GROUP BY
  ppath.grade_group
ORDER BY
  patient_count DESC
LIMIT 100
correction_reason: 로봇 수술 여부는 ILIKE '%robot%'이 아니라 inhosp_op_eng_nm의 실제 값(Robotic/Robot-assisted 계열)을 IN절로 명시해야 함

question: 로봇수술을 받은 환자들의 병기 분포를 알려줘
intent: count patients by disease stage among robot surgery cohort
sql: SELECT pi.dis_stage, COUNT(DISTINCT po.s_patno) AS patient_count FROM poc.poc_prostate_op po JOIN poc.poc_prostate_patient_info pi ON po.s_patno = pi.s_patno WHERE po.inhosp_op_eng_nm IN ('Robotic Radical Prostatectomy (da Vinci)', 'Robot-assisted Radical Prostatectomy', 'Robot-assisted Laparoscopic Radical Prostatectomy') GROUP BY pi.dis_stage ORDER BY pi.dis_stage

question: 암종 소분류별로 환자가 가장 많은 병기를 알려줘
intent: top disease stage per cancer subtype
sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT crcn_sm_nm, dis_stage, COUNT(DISTINCT s_patno) AS patient_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY crcn_sm_nm ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT s_patno) DESC) AS rn FROM poc.poc_prostate_patient_info GROUP BY crcn_sm_nm, dis_stage) SELECT crcn_sm_nm, dis_stage, patient_count FROM counts WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY crcn_sm_nm

question: CT 또는 MRI에서 양성 소견이 나온 환자의 병기를 함께 보여줘
intent: list patients with positive ct or mri finding and disease stage
sql: SELECT DISTINCT sr.s_patno, pi.dis_stage FROM poc.poc_sslrdexrt sr JOIN poc.poc_prostate_patient_info pi ON sr.s_patno = pi.s_patno WHERE sr.exam_cd IN ('CT001', 'MRI001') AND sr.mark_rslt_val = 'Positive' ORDER BY sr.s_patno

question: PSA 수치가 4.0 이상이고 Gleason Grade Group이 4 이상인 환자를 보여줘
intent: list patients with high psa and high gleason grade group
sql: SELECT DISTINCT pb.s_patno FROM poc.poc_prostate_blood pb JOIN poc.poc_prostate_path pp ON pb.s_patno = pp.s_patno WHERE pb.ordr_cd = 'PSA001' AND pb.mark_rslt_val::float >= 4.0 AND pp.grade_group::int >= 4 ORDER BY pb.s_patno

question: 호르몬 치료제를 처방받았고 응급수술 이력이 있는 환자의 병기를 보여줘
intent: list patients with hormone therapy and emergency surgery, disease stage
sql: SELECT DISTINCT od.s_patno, pi.dis_stage FROM poc.poc_ooodmordr od JOIN poc.poc_prostate_op po ON od.s_patno = po.s_patno JOIN poc.poc_prostate_patient_info pi ON od.s_patno = pi.s_patno WHERE od.ordr_cd IN ('ADT001', 'ADT002') AND po.emrcy_op_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY od.s_patno

question: 전립선암 환자는 총 몇 명인가요?
intent: count
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s_patno) FROM poc.poc_prostate_patient_info
sql_before_edit:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s_patno) AS patient_count
FROM poc.poc_prostate_patient_info
ORDER BY patient_count

question: 수술 종류별 건수를 알려줘
intent: count surgeries grouped by type
sql: SELECT inhosp_op_eng_nm, COUNT(*) AS op_count FROM poc.poc_prostate_op GROUP BY inhosp_op_eng_nm ORDER BY op_count DESC

question: 집도과별 수술 건수를 알려줘
intent: count surgeries grouped by department
sql: SELECT opdp_cd, COUNT(*) AS op_count FROM poc.poc_prostate_op GROUP BY opdp_cd ORDER BY op_count DESC

question: 병리 검사 결과 등급 분포를 알려줘
intent: count pathology exams grouped by score
sql: SELECT score, COUNT(*) AS exam_count FROM poc.poc_prostate_path GROUP BY score ORDER BY score

question: 처방코드별 검사 건수를 보여줘
intent: count blood test exams grouped by order code
sql: SELECT ordr_cd, COUNT(*) AS exam_count FROM poc.poc_prostate_blood GROUP BY ordr_cd ORDER BY exam_count DESC

question: 환자별 수술 이력과 병리 검사 결과를 함께 보여줘
intent: list surgery history joined with pathology results
sql: SELECT po.s_patno, po.op_dt, po.inhosp_op_eng_nm, pp.gleason, pp.grade_group FROM poc.poc_prostate_op po JOIN poc.poc_prostate_path pp ON po.s_patno = pp.s_patno ORDER BY po.s_patno LIMIT 100

question: 연령대별로 가장 많이 시행된 수술 종류를 알려줘
intent: top surgery type per age band
sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT pi.age_10_sect_nm, po.inhosp_op_eng_nm, COUNT(*) AS op_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pi.age_10_sect_nm ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM poc.poc_prostate_patient_info pi JOIN poc.poc_prostate_op po ON pi.s_patno = po.s_patno GROUP BY pi.age_10_sect_nm, po.inhosp_op_eng_nm) SELECT age_10_sect_nm, inhosp_op_eng_nm, op_count FROM counts WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY age_10_sect_nm

question: 집도과별 응급수술 비율을 알려줘
intent: emergency surgery ratio per department
sql: SELECT opdp_cd, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE emrcy_op_yn = 'Y')::numeric / COUNT(*), 4) AS emrcy_ratio FROM poc.poc_prostate_op GROUP BY opdp_cd ORDER BY emrcy_ratio DESC

question: 응급수술을 받은 환자의 병기 분포를 보여줘
intent: disease stage distribution among emergency surgery patients
sql: SELECT pi.dis_stage, COUNT(DISTINCT po.s_patno) AS patient_count FROM poc.poc_prostate_op po JOIN poc.poc_prostate_patient_info pi ON po.s_patno = pi.s_patno WHERE po.emrcy_op_yn = 'Y' GROUP BY pi.dis_stage ORDER BY pi.dis_stage

question: PSA 수치가 10 이상인 환자는 몇 명인가요?
intent: count patients with high psa
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s_patno) FROM poc.poc_prostate_blood WHERE ordr_cd = 'PSA001' AND mark_rslt_val::float >= 10

question: 로봇수술 후 PSA 수치가 0.2 이상으로 재상승한 생화학적 재발 환자의 수술 종류와 Gleason Grade Group을 보여줘
intent: list biochemical recurrence patients after robot surgery with surgery type and gleason grade group
sql: SELECT DISTINCT po.s_patno, po.inhosp_op_eng_nm, pp.grade_group FROM poc.poc_prostate_op po JOIN poc.poc_prostate_path pp ON po.s_patno = pp.s_patno WHERE po.inhosp_op_eng_nm IN ('Robot-assisted Radical Prostatectomy', 'Robotic Radical Prostatectomy (da Vinci)', 'Robot-assisted Laparoscopic Radical Prostatectomy') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM poc.poc_prostate_blood pb WHERE pb.s_patno = po.s_patno AND pb.ordr_cd = 'PSA001' AND TO_DATE(pb.ordr_direct_dt, 'YYYYMMDD') > TO_DATE(po.op_dt, 'YYYYMMDD') AND pb.mark_rslt_val::numeric >= 0.2) ORDER BY po.s_patno LIMIT 100
sql_before_edit: SELECT po.s_patno, po.inhosp_op_eng_nm, pp.grade_group FROM poc.poc_prostate_op po JOIN poc.poc_prostate_path pp ON po.s_patno = pp.s_patno JOIN poc.poc_prostate_blood pb ON po.s_patno = pb.s_patno WHERE po.inhosp_op_eng_nm IN ('Robot-assisted Radical Prostatectomy', 'Robotic Radical Prostatectomy (da Vinci)', 'Robot-assisted Laparoscopic Radical Prostatectomy') AND pb.ordr_cd = 'PSA001' AND pb.mark_rslt_val::numeric >= 0.2 ORDER BY po.s_patno LIMIT 100
correction_reason: PSA 재검사를 단순 JOIN으로 걸면 같은 환자가 검사 횟수만큼 중복 집계되고, 그 수치가 수술 이후 시점인지도 확인되지 않음 — EXISTS 서브쿼리로 바꾸고 TO_DATE 비교로 '수술 이후 재검사'라는 조건을 명시해야 함

question: 전신골스캔 또는 PET에서 골전이가 의심됐고 병기가 III기 이상인 환자의 Gleason Grade Group을 보여줘
intent: list bone metastasis suspected patients with advanced stage and gleason grade group
sql: SELECT DISTINCT sn.s_patno, pi.dis_stage, pp.grade_group FROM poc.poc_ssnudexrt sn JOIN poc.poc_prostate_patient_info pi ON sn.s_patno = pi.s_patno JOIN poc.poc_prostate_path pp ON sn.s_patno = pp.s_patno WHERE sn.exam_cd IN ('BONE001', 'PET001') AND sn.mark_rslt_val = 'Positive' AND pi.dis_stage IN ('III', 'IV') ORDER BY sn.s_patno LIMIT 100
sql_before_edit: SELECT DISTINCT sn.s_patno, pi.dis_stage, pp.grade_group FROM poc.poc_ssnudexrt sn JOIN poc.poc_prostate_patient_info pi ON sn.s_patno = pi.s_patno JOIN poc.poc_prostate_path pp ON sn.s_patno = pp.s_patno WHERE sn.exam_rslt_val ILIKE '%양성%' AND pi.dis_stage IN ('III', 'IV') ORDER BY sn.s_patno LIMIT 100
correction_reason: 양성 판정은 원문 텍스트(exam_rslt_val)가 아니라 정규화된 판정값 컬럼(mark_rslt_val='Positive')으로 확인해야 하고, exam_cd를 BONE001/PET001로 명시해야 골스캔·PET 검사로 한정됨 — ILIKE 방식은 원문 표기가 제각각이라 일부 양성 건을 놓침

question: 로봇 수술을 받았고 호르몬 치료도 받았으며 PSA 수치가 10 이상인 환자는 몇 명인가요?
intent: count patients with robot surgery, hormone therapy, and high psa
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT po.s_patno) FROM poc.poc_prostate_op po JOIN poc.poc_ooodmordr od ON po.s_patno = od.s_patno JOIN poc.poc_prostate_blood pb ON po.s_patno = pb.s_patno WHERE po.inhosp_op_eng_nm IN ('Robot-assisted Radical Prostatectomy', 'Robotic Radical Prostatectomy (da Vinci)', 'Robot-assisted Laparoscopic Radical Prostatectomy') AND od.ordr_cd IN ('ADT001', 'ADT002') AND pb.ordr_cd = 'PSA001' AND pb.mark_rslt_val::float >= 10
sql_before_edit: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT po.s_patno) FROM poc.poc_prostate_op po JOIN poc.poc_ooodmordr od ON po.s_patno = od.s_patno JOIN poc.poc_prostate_blood pb ON po.s_patno = pb.s_patno WHERE po.inhosp_op_eng_nm ILIKE '%robot%' AND od.ordr_cd IN ('ADT001', 'ADT002') AND pb.exam_cd = 'PSA001' AND pb.mark_rslt_val::float >= 10
correction_reason: 두 가지 오류를 함께 수정 — ① 로봇 수술 판별은 ILIKE '%robot%' 대신 inhosp_op_eng_nm 실제 값 목록으로, ② PSA 코드는 blood 테이블의 ordr_cd 컬럼에 있는데 exam_cd 컬럼에 넣는 바람에 조건이 항상 거짓이 되어 결과가 0건으로 나왔음

question: Gleason Grade Group 5 비율이 가장 높은 연령대와 그 비율을 알려줘
intent: age band with highest gleason grade group 5 ratio
sql: WITH ratios AS (SELECT pi.age_10_sect_nm, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pp.grade_group = '5') AS grade5_count, COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM poc.poc_prostate_patient_info pi JOIN poc.poc_prostate_path pp ON pi.s_patno = pp.s_patno GROUP BY pi.age_10_sect_nm) SELECT age_10_sect_nm, grade5_count, total_count, ROUND(grade5_count::numeric / total_count, 4) AS grade5_ratio FROM ratios ORDER BY grade5_ratio DESC LIMIT 1
sql_before_edit: SELECT pi.age_10_sect_nm, AVG(CASE WHEN pp.grade_group = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS grade5_ratio FROM poc.poc_prostate_patient_info pi JOIN poc.poc_prostate_path pp ON pi.s_patno = pp.s_patno GROUP BY pi.age_10_sect_nm ORDER BY grade5_ratio DESC LIMIT 1
correction_reason: grade_group은 TEXT 컬럼이라 정수 5와 비교하면 타입 오류가 나고, AVG(CASE...) 방식은 분자/분모 정의가 불명확함 — COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE grade_group='5')로 조건부 집계한 뒤 전체 건수 대비 비율을 명시적으로 계산해야 함
